snippet.title: Project: Nova Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Solve puzzles in VR, Explore the Nova Aurora, Repair its damaged systems! 
As the last engineer onboard, experience the isolation of being stranded alone. 
As you progress through the story you will face puzzles and consequences which will determine the fate of the voyage. 
How will you proceed?
